topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Workforce use rules in POL-02 Part C with a Spanish summary for field staff; sanctions rule in POL-02 A.4
gap: No signed acknowledgments yet
remediation: Signed acknowledgments in English and Spanish from all 5 year-round staff now and from H-2A workers at season start (POL-02 C.6)

control_description: No board: the farm is a single-owner LLC. The Owner and General Manager reviews security monthly with the Security Coordinator (30-minute POA&M meeting) starting 2026-09
gap: Oversight just started; no record yet
remediation: Keep monthly meeting notes with POA&M status

control_description: Office Manager designated Security Coordinator in writing on 2026-08-31; roles in POL-02 section 3 and SSP section 5; MSP duties in the MSP contract
evidence: EV-053 (designation letter); POL-02; SSP section 5; EV-017 (MSP contract)

control_description: Technician holds an FAA remote pilot certificate; Produce Safety training at hire in English and Spanish; no security training
evidence: EV-030 (training roster; remote pilot certificate copy)
gap: No security awareness training; no Spanish-language security material
remediation: Annual training in English and Spanish and monthly crew-meeting tips (POAM-012)

control_description: Sanctions rule in POL-02 A.4; security duties in role descriptions
gap: Not yet applied; no record of accountability in practice
remediation: Operate the policies through one season; record any sanction applied

control_description: None: no inventory of IT devices, OT and IoT devices, SaaS services, or places Restricted data lives
evidence: EV-009 (MSP device list, 3 office computers only)
gap: No inventory; about 30 OT and IoT devices known only to the Technician
remediation: One-page inventory with firmware versions and data locations (POL-04 4.4; P03 G-032, G-033, G-037)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Three policies approved; incident reporting rule in POL-03 4.2
gap: Policies and the reporting rule not yet communicated to staff
remediation: Crew briefing in English and Spanish; reporting cards at the shop, the pump station, and in the field kit (POAM-013)

control_description: Grower agreement sets 24-hour notice to the packer-shipper; P08 notification matrix lists outside parties
gap: No named security contact for the packer-shipper; no breach contact registered with the payroll service or the H-2A filing agent
remediation: Send this summary with the questionnaire answers and name the Security Coordinator as contact; register the Security Coordinator as breach contact (POAM-010)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk tolerance and acceptance authority set; BIA recovery objectives for 8 processes
evidence: POL-02 A.3; P01 section 1; P05 BIA

control_description: 2026 risk assessment with NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (23 risks) covering the farm and its key vendors
Fraud scenarios assessed: payment diversion by business email compromise (R-006) and wrong or disputed hours records (R-009); the bank calls back before adding any payee
evidence: P01 R-006 and R-009; EV-029 (bank callback procedure)

control_description: Risk assessment updated after major changes (P01 section 5); new suppliers, apps, and devices approved under POL-04 4.5
gap: No trigger yet to catch changes such as dealer program changes or new AI features
remediation: Supplier checklist and change log in use (P03 G-045)

control_description: Independent control assessment 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-13, including OT tests
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M (13 items) and reviewed monthly with the Owner and General Manager

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected in the SSP from the Moderate baseline, tailored for a 7-person farm
gap: Of 42 controls, 6 are implemented, 24 partially implemented, and 12 planned
remediation: Complete the POA&M

control_description: MSP patches and runs antivirus on the 3 office computers under contract
gap: No general controls over the OT (firmware, settings baseline, dealer sessions) or over tablets and phones
remediation: Approved and logged dealer sessions (POAM-009); OT settings baseline; mobile device settings

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Three policies approved (POL-02, POL-03, POL-04)
gap: Procedures not yet written: account checklists, hand-operation procedure, restore test record
remediation: Onboarding, season-end, and departure checklists; restore test record; hand-operation procedure

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: MFA on the productivity suite for 3 office users and on the Owner and General Manager's SYS-01 account; SaaS encryption; laptops encrypted
evidence: EV-007 (suite security settings); EV-004 (SYS-01 security settings); EV-011 (MSP encryption report)
gap: No MFA on the Technician's SYS-01 administrator account, the backup console, the gateway, or the Field Supervisor's mailbox
remediation: MFA for every SYS-01 user and mailbox and the backup console (POAM-008)

control_description: Office Manager grants access verbally; the crew shares one SYS-01 login
evidence: EV-003 (SYS-01 user list); EV-007 (suite user list); EV-AC-2 (account management test)
gap: No approval record or onboarding checklist; shared field crew login
remediation: Onboarding checklist; named crew accounts with tablet PINs (POAM-001)

control_description: SYS-01 roles (the crew role cannot change irrigation)
gap: Former bookkeeper mailbox active 6 months (disabled 2026-07-21); stale dealer accounts in the telematics portal (removed 2026-08-14); Office folder shared with 4 users; no access reviews
remediation: Departure and season-end checklists; monthly reconciliation; restrict the Office folder (POAM-001)

control_description: Farm office locked when unattended; pump station panel padlocked; vendor data centers covered by the FMIS vendor SOC 2 report
gap: River Tract pivot panels unlocked in open fields
remediation: Locks on the River Tract pivot panels (P03 G-058)

control_description: Paper with personal information shredded in the office
gap: Old desktop given away in 2025 with no recorded wipe; no disposal records
remediation: Wipe or certified destruction with a record for every device (POL-04 4.7; P03 G-122)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Shop firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic
gap: Flat network reaches the pump station from the shop Wi-Fi; the dealer gateway bypasses the firewall and its admin page accepted the default password from the internet until 2026-08-14
remediation: Pump station segment and guest Wi-Fi (POAM-006); gateway on request only with named MFA accounts (POAM-002, POAM-007)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all SaaS; pivot commands over the carrier private cellular network; payroll and H-2A documents to agents through their portals (POL-04 4.2)
gap: Office folder synced to the unencrypted office desktop; no control on automatic forwarding
remediation: Stop syncing and restrict the Office folder; encrypt the desktop; block automatic external forwarding (R-005, R-010)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: MSP antivirus on the desktop and both laptops; detection and quarantine work (P07 test)
evidence: EV-013 (MSP antivirus export); EV-SI-3 (P07 SI-3 results)
gap: Alerts reach the MSP only in business hours; no behavior-based detection; tablets and phones unmanaged
remediation: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerts by text (POAM-005)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: MSP patches office computers monthly
gap: No vulnerability scanning; gateway and controller firmware never updated
remediation: Quarterly MSP scans; dealer-tested firmware updates each winter (POAM-011)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: None: nobody reviews SYS-01, suite, or firewall logs; SYS-01 irrigation change alerts switched off
gap: No monitoring of irrigation commands, sign-ins, or firewall events
remediation: SYS-01 irrigation change alerts to two phones (R-003); monthly log review; EDR alerts (POAM-005)

control_description: Incident log and breach determination required by POL-03 4.4 and 4.5
gap: The 2025 phishing event and lost tablet were never recorded; process not yet used
remediation: Start the incident log; reporting cards and crew briefing (POAM-013)

control_description: Ransomware runbook with the MSP, the insurer, and the irrigation dealer in the chain (approved 2026-08-31)
gap: Not tested
remediation: Tabletop with the MSP and the dealer (POAM-004)

control_description: FMIS vendor platform backups; nightly SYS-08 copy of the suite with 30 days of versions
evidence: EV-052 (FMIS vendor SOC 2 report); EV-015 (SYS-08 job report)
gap: SYS-08 never restore-tested; SYS-01 records never exported; controller program held only by the dealer
remediation: Restore tests; monthly SYS-01 export; farm-held program copy (POAM-003, POAM-004)

control_description: None: the dealer changes the pump station program remotely without telling the farm
evidence: EV-MA-4 (gateway connection history, 9 unapproved sessions in 2026)
gap: No change approval or change log
remediation: Change log approved by the Technician; dealer changes only in approved sessions (POAM-009; P03 G-045)

control_description: BIA completed; cyber insurance with a breach hotline; every pump and pivot can be run by hand
gap: No contingency plan; only one person can run irrigation by hand
remediation: Contingency plan with the hand-operation procedure; second person trained and drilled (POAM-004)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: FMIS vendor SOC 2 report reviewed 2026-08-20 (vendor-soc2-review.csv); supplier checklist in POL-02 A.5
gap: No security terms for the irrigation dealer, the equipment dealer, or the AI vendor; no MSP incident notice term; MSP never reviewed
remediation: Dealer and AI vendor terms by 2026-10-31; MSP and equipment dealer amendments; annual MSP review (POAM-010)

control_description: Capacity of SYS-01 and the suite managed by the vendors (FMIS vendor SOC 2 covers Availability); field phones, pivots, and probes use their own cellular links. The single shop internet line was accepted as a Low risk (R-012)
evidence: EV-052 (FMIS vendor SOC 2 report); EV-033 (internet service agreement); P01 R-012 acceptance

control_description: FMIS vendor backups (RPO 1 hour); nightly SYS-08 copy with 30 days of versions; small battery backup for office computers
evidence: EV-052 (FMIS vendor SOC 2 report); EV-015 (SYS-08 job report)
gap: SYS-08 not immutable and administered with one password-only account; no farm-held SYS-01 export or controller program copy; no surge protection on the pump station
remediation: 90-day immutable versions with MFA (POAM-003); monthly export; surge protection on the pump station panel (R-013)

control_description: None
gap: No restore test, exercise, or hand-operation drill
remediation: Quarterly restore tests; annual tabletop; hand-operation drill before the season (POAM-004)
